eventName: Giving 500 yellow bags to common people ceremony
eventDescription:
Kanchipuram Pollution Control Board, Seeds Volunteer Organization, Triveni Academy, and Ramanujar Lion Sangam jointly organized an awareness march at Sriperumbudur Bus Stand under the theme ?Plastic bags instead of plastic bags?.

Sriperumbudur Taluka Magistrate Mrs. Vasanthi and Police Inspector Mr. Dharmalingam participated as special guests and inaugurated the function by distributing plastic bags to the public.

Later, the students enthusiastically marched in a procession, chanting the slogan ?No plastic ? use plastic bags!? and highlighted the need for environmental protection to the public around the bus stand.

More than 500 plastic bags were distributed to the public as a symbol of awareness.

If you want to do something good for this earth, one is to plant trees and the other is to avoid using plastic. This is the best debt of gratitude we can give to this earth.
